items.name: Pirelli
items.notes: Confirmed BSB control tyre supplier (2025 season). Pirelli Diablo Superbike compound spec set by MCRCB per year. Also widely used on UK track days — SC1/SC2/SC3 compounds popular. Never invent pressures; cite rider/manufacturer datasheet.

items.name: Bridgestone
items.notes: Battlax RS11 and V02 compounds common on UK track days. Refer to manufacturer datasheet for pressures.

items.name: Dunlop
items.notes: KR108/Sportmax Alpha compound range used on UK track days and club racing. Popular in Clubman classes.

items.name: Michelin
items.notes: Power Cup / Power Slick range used on UK track days. Michelin MotoGP supplier globally. Check manufacturer datasheet for pressures.

items.name: Alpinestars (UK distributor)
items.notes: Leading UK/BSB leathers and boot supplier. Nomex undergarment requirements vary by event — check supplementary regs.

items.name: Arai Helmets
items.notes: BSB competitor popular choice. ACU requires ECE 22.06 or FIM approved helmet for race events.

items.name: Shoei Helmets
items.notes: BSB competitor popular choice. ECE 22.06 standard required for ACU events.

items.name: Datatag (bike registration)
items.notes: ACU-endorsed security marking system for race bikes.

items.name: TwoTyres (tyre fitting / supply)
items.notes: UK track day tyre supplier attending many circuit events for fitting; guide at twotyres.co.uk/motorcycle-trackday-tyres-guide.
